prose: An essay asks what reasoning training really optimizes. The simple view says longer thinking gives better answers, but forcing a trained model to think longer helps only for a while and can hurt, which fits poorly with convergence to an optimum. It frames reasoning as pathfinding in token space rather than simple deliberation.
highlights: Longer chains help in RL training but not when forced later
Proposes reasoning as pathfinding in token space
basis: Based on the opening of the essay
